_comment: WORDING — every piece of on-screen text for one screen or menu, each in its own editable box, already filled in. He retypes the ones he wants different; untouched ones stand.

Use it instead of a pick-one question per label. Fill each box with the words on screen today, or the ones you propose — never an empty box (Destin, 2026-11-10: "should be pre-filled with the suggested or existing copy").
Give the rows a `picture` of the screen the words sit on, so he sees them in context (same answer: "a screenshot of the actual menu in the app"). One picture on the first row of a screen is enough.
His changes arrive as answers[step].edits[<row id>] = the new words. A box he left alone is not in the file.
